LA01.en: A vast Tang dynasty throne hall filled with kneeling envoys from many nations, Emperor Taizong seated on the dragon throne in dark ceremonial robes and beaded crown, courtiers prostrated in long rows, red lacquered pillars, gold incense smoke drifting in shafts of light, low-angle wide shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
LA01.beat: 太极殿万邦来朝，李世民端坐御座冕旒低垂

LA02.en: A steppe khan in fur-trimmed lamellar armor kneeling on stone steps to offer a golden crown upward, the crown catching cold daylight, rows of Tang officials flanking the stairs, banners snapping in wind, medium close-up on the crown between two hands, photorealistic, cinematic.
LA02.beat: 草原可汗单膝跪献金冠，“天可汗”桂冠特写

LA03.en: A Tang dynasty court historian bent over a low desk writing with a fine brush, tall stacks of eulogy scrolls rising like a wall behind him, inkstone and seal, dim paper-filtered daylight, dust motes in the air, medium shot, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, cinematic.
LA03.beat: 史官伏案执笔，颂词卷帙堆叠如墙

LS04.en: Close-up of ancient Chinese official court chronicle volumes bound in yellow silk, a brush heavily crossing out lines of calligraphy, fresh black ink over older red cinnabar annotations, stacked bamboo slips beside, raking daylight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS04.beat: 评书味的源头：贞观年间重洗的官方实录

LA05.en: An emperor's golden crown lying askew on deep crimson silk that spreads like spilled liquid across a polished stone floor, reflections breaking apart, a single shaft of cold light from above, extreme close-up, deep shadows, photorealistic, cinematic.
LA05.beat: 血泊中沉浮的帝王冠冕

LA06.en: Shadow puppets on a glowing paper screen depicting two identical armored brothers fighting, a storyteller's hand holding the rods, teahouse lanterns behind, warm orange backlight, silhouettes only, medium shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
LA06.beat: 戏台皮影：被简化成忠奸二分的剪影

LA07.en: A large bronze gear mechanism interlocking, hand-forged teeth catching, cold blue-grey light along the metal edges, engraved Tang dynasty patterns on the housing, macro close-up, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, cinematic.
LA07.beat: 青铜齿轮咬合传动，冷光森然

LS13.en: A young strategist's rolled battle map dropped unnoticed on a dusty floor beside the hoof-print-churned ground of an approaching steppe army, harsh midday light, sense of irrelevance, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS13.beat: 神机妙算在几十万铁骑面前一文不值

LS10.en: A powerful aristocratic clan head in formal dark silk seated in an ancestral hall, banners of the Eight Pillars of Northern Zhou behind him, stern composed face, incense smoke, symmetrical imposing composition, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS10.beat: 李渊真面目：北周八柱国、陇西李氏大当家

LA10.en: A dark ancestral hall at dusk, a large clan genealogy chart unrolled on silk showing three ruling houses joined by criss-crossing red threads, bronze lamps casting pools of amber light, brush and tally slips on the table, medium-wide shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
LA10.beat: 暗室内三朝联姻谱系，红线交错如网

LS08.en: A fifty-two-year-old commander standing atop a city gate tower at night looking down, below him through a cutaway cellar three hidden furnaces glowing orange, freshly cast bronze coins pouring from pottery moulds into wooden crates, sparks rising, dramatic firelight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS08.beat: 城楼上的李渊与三座地下钱炉

LS01.en: A middle-aged Sui dynasty nobleman slumped at a low wooden table in a dim hall, wine cup tipped over, silk robes disheveled, expression of vacant indulgence, scattered bronze coins and empty jugs on the floor, warm amber lamplight, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS01.beat: 史书神话：醉眼惺忪的守财奴李渊

LS05.en: A lone surviving manuscript scroll with scorched edges resting on a campaign camp writing desk, candle stub burning low, a scholar-official in travel-stained robes writing by its light inside a military tent, shafts of dusk light through felt flaps, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS05.beat: 温大雅《大唐创业起居注》孤本

LS24.en: Officials with measuring rods and registers surveying fallow riverbank land, clusters of displaced farming families watching, Wei river willows, overcast daylight, documentary realism, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS24.beat: 清丈渭水两岸荒地，核查流民

LS25.en: A pontoon bridge of lashed boats across a swift yellow river, blacksmiths re-forging iron mooring cables on the bank, grain barges waiting, overcast northern light, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS25.beat: 永丰仓军粮与蒲津关浮桥

LS48.en: Smoke over Hebei villages after a failed pacification by execution, displaced families on a road at dusk, a general's banner passing in frustration, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS47.en: Three civil officials in plain dark robes in conference in the Eastern Palace library, scrolls and maps spread on a low table, none of them of the Guanlong military clans, calm daylight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS47.beat: 东宫班底：魏征、王珪、李纲

LB07.en: Interior of a Tang throne hall with two massive lacquered pillars standing side by side, identical shadows cast left and right across the stone floor, empty space between them, late afternoon light raking low, symmetrical wide shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
LB07.beat: 太极殿双柱并立，阴影左右对称

LB08.en: A large bronze balance scale in a dim hall, one pan holding stacked official registers and a seal, the other holding miniature cavalry banners and a helmet, pans perfectly level, single overhead lamp, medium shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
LB08.beat: 天平两端：一端文册官印，一端铁骑旌旗

LB09.en: A lit fuse burning along a coiled cord on a dark stone floor, sparks scattering, smoke curling upward, sparks reflected in a bronze mirror nearby, extreme close-up, deep black background, photorealistic, cinematic.
LB09.beat: 定时炸弹引信燃烧，滴答作响

LS29.en: Deep winter siege lines on a frozen hillside, soldiers' cloth boots rotted through with frost and mud, a commander who has not removed his armor for two nights, hoarfrost on iron, pale freezing light, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS29.beat: 柏壁寒冬，布鞋冻烂在脚上

LS30.en: Three thousand five hundred heavy cavalry in black lacquered iron armor packed into a narrow mountain pass at dawn, motionless, spears upright, like an iron nail driven into the gorge, cold blue dawn light, photorealistic, cinematic wide shot.
LS30.beat: 虎牢关：三千五百玄甲幽州突骑

LS27.en: A young prince in battered black armor standing amid the aftermath of a battlefield at dusk, torn banners, fallen men and horses, exhausted but unbroken, cold blue-grey light, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS55.en: An extraordinary new patent of office being presented in a throne hall, no precedent for its rank, the recipient's face unreadable, courtiers whispering, bright formal light, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS56.en: A prince's own administrative staff being sworn in at a long table, maps of Luoyang and the eastern plains on the wall behind, quiet assumption of parallel government, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS56.beat: 自置官属与洛阳关东统辖权

LS57.en: A stream of armored officers entering a great mansion gate at dusk, welcomed by staff, the household swelling beyond its walls, warm interior light spilling out, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS57.beat: 天策府成了政治避难所

LS58.en: Iron filings gathering around a lodestone on a campaign map, and behind them the faces of hard-bitten cavalry commanders drawing close to a young prince, warm dusk light, metaphor rendered literally and physically, photorealistic, cinematic.

LB17.en: A tiger tally of cast bronze lying beside a row of official seals and sealed documents on a lacquered desk, two distinct sets facing each other, cold morning window light from the left, overhead close-up, photorealistic, cinematic.
LB17.beat: 虎符与文官印信并置，两套班底对峙

LS35.en: A young victor in gilded chainmail walking through the Vermilion Bird Gate, and above on the gate tower the aging emperor gripping the rail with visibly damp palms, the two men's eyes not meeting, bright but uneasy daylight, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS35.beat: 黄金锁子甲踏进朱雀门，老皇帝手心冷汗

LS60.en: A great imperial machine being re-cast in the dark, military gears being pried out and replaced with bureaucratic ones, sparks, night, irreversible transformation, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS60.beat: 军事拓殖期向官僚帝国期的生死反扑

LC01.en: Two men facing each other across a weiqi board in an Eastern Palace study at dusk, one in crown prince robes and one in scholar's robes, a dense tangle of black stones pressing inward, oil lamp between them, over-the-board medium shot, warm lamp glow, photorealistic, cinematic.
LC01.beat: 东宫书房：建成与魏征对弈，棋局步步紧逼

LS61.en: Transfer orders being issued in a ministry while steppe raid smoke rises on the northern horizon beyond the window, dusk, cold administrative light against distant fire, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS61.beat: 借突厥寇边之名调动天策府兵将

LC03.en: An emptied military camp at dusk, bare tent frames, weapon racks picked clean, cooking pots overturned, dust hanging in the low light, a single empty saddle on the ground, wide desolate shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
LC03.beat: 被抽空的军营，兵甲尽去

LC04.en: A walled princely residence at night seen from a side alley, torch lights of patrolling guards moving along the outer streets, watching figures standing in shadows at the corners, cold blue moonlight on roof tiles, wide exterior shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
LC04.beat: 秦王府被暗哨合围，火把在街巷游动

LS66.en: A young prince being carried into a darkened mansion after a palace banquet, a servant's cloth stained with blood, overturned wine cups left behind, oil-lamp light, photorealistic, cinematic.

LC06.en: A young Tang dynasty prince sitting alone in a dim room, a cup of wine on the table reflecting the flame of a single candle, a drawn sword lying just out of focus behind, face half in shadow, close-up, photorealistic, cinematic.
LC06.beat: 烛影独坐，杯中酒映出一线刀光

LC07.en: An empty stone prison cell lit by a narrow shaft from a high barred window, iron chains hanging unused against the wall, straw on the floor, cold grey light, wide static shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
LC07.beat: 空荡囚室与未落下的诏狱铁链

LS65.en: A prince alone at a board game with every piece already lost, three scrolls of legitimate procedure beside him, low dusk light, defeat rendered without violence, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS65.beat: 论名分论行政论后援，全输光

LS67.en: A shadowed room at night, faces of professional killers, cavalry officers and conspirators half-lit, a map of survival rather than ambition, no law books anywhere, hard low-key lighting, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS67.beat: 杀手网络被逼到绝境，不会讲程序正义

LC10.en: A lone armored prince standing in the shadow of a high palace wall, torchlight just beyond the corner behind him, shoulders squared, face unreadable, dusk sky above the wall, low-angle medium shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
LC10.beat: 孤立无援的秦王立于宫墙阴影里

LC11.en: A dark room interior with red threads stretched taut between iron nails on the walls forming an intricate web, small wooden name tags at each intersection, a single lamp below, camera looking slightly upward into the web, photorealistic, cinematic.
LC11.beat: 深不可测的关系网，暗室中红线纵横

LS54.en: A prince silhouetted against a looming mountain range that reads almost as a fortified compound, unseen masses behind him, low dusk light, scale and threat, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS54.beat: 算漏的一整座山：天策府

LS59.en: A vast net of administrative documents drawn tight across one half of a hall while hundreds of scarred veterans are pressed against the far wall, dusk light, structural confrontation, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS59.beat: 文官化收网 vs 百战功臣绝境

LS53.en: Senior armored nobles standing in a palace courtyard while a written rule is posted, their armor suddenly out of place among civil officials, long dusk shadows, photorealistic, cinematic.

LD01.en: An antique bronze compass-rose device on a dark table, its pointer stopped toward a carved gate model beside it, candlelight glinting on the metal, shallow depth of field, overhead close-up, photorealistic, cinematic.
LD01.beat: 命运罗盘转动，指针停在玄武门

LS69.en: A mid-ranking guard commander in the livery of the Eastern Palace standing watch at a heavy northern palace gate in freezing November wind, face unreadable, frost on the gate studs, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS72.en: Close-up in darkness of an iron lock being replaced on a massive vermilion palace gate, a hand withdrawing a new key, moonlight edge, silence, photorealistic, cinematic.

LD04.en: A Tang dynasty Dunhuang manuscript scroll lying open inside a glass display case in a foreign museum, dense vertical brushwork, aged paper with stains, cold institutional lighting, reflections on the glass, close-up at an angle, photorealistic, cinematic.
LD04.beat: 敦煌写本经卷静卧异国玻璃柜中

LS71.en: A folded-edge steel gold-inlaid blade and several open chests of gold ingots on a plain table in a lamplit room, the light warm on metal, the recipient's hand hovering, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS71.beat: 折刃金刀与几箱沉甸甸的黄金

LS70.en: A single hooded emissary knocking at a small side door of a guard commander's house deep at night, one lantern, no escort, still street, photorealistic, cinematic.

LS73.en: A palace courtyard of grey brick after rain, still puddles mirroring a cold waning moon, black rooflines, absolute quiet before dawn, blue-black night, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS73.beat: 雨停，青砖积水倒映残月

LS74.en: Two men in coarse Taoist priest robes slipping through a shadowed service entrance of a prince's mansion at night, hoods low, one lamp in a servant's hand, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS74.beat: 房玄龄杜如晦化装成道士潜回

LS76.en: A prince writing a memorial by guttering candlelight at a low desk, brush moving steadily, the paper accusing his own brothers, shadows large on the wall, photorealistic, cinematic.

LD10.en: A steel blade half drawn from its scabbard, the exposed edge reflecting candlelight, hand resting on the hilt, dark background, extreme close-up, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, cinematic.
LD10.beat: 半出鞘的横刀映着烛火

LD11.en: Morning mist creeping between the eaves and battlements of a Tang palace wall at dawn, layered roofs disappearing into pale fog, no people, cold blue-grey palette, wide shot, photorealistic, cinematic.
LD11.beat: 雨停，晨雾在太极宫城楼间蔓延

LS77.en: Nine warhorses tethered in a dark stable, wooden bits wedged in their mouths, hooves wrapped in thick hemp cloth, a groom's hand silencing one, single lantern, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS77.beat: 九匹战马塞木棍裹麻布

LS78.en: First grey light on the massive vermilion gate of a palace, an immense orderly structure about to be struck, a heavy iron hammer resting in the foreground, cold pre-dawn palette, photorealistic, cinematic.
LS78.beat: 秩序大厦即将迎来最血腥的一记重锤
